rules.rule: Scope: suspended in-situ RC flights and half landings. Precast flights with half joints not covered. Grade normally 30/37, max aggregate 20.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Cover (solid slab): internal max(15, dia)+dcdev; external 35+dcdev. Top cover also applies at the throat. Extra 10 mm on top wearing surface where no applied finish.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Standard cover 20 internal / 40 external; MST1/MST2: min 20 or bar size.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: As,min = max(0.26 bt d fctm/fyk, 0.0013 bt d); for 30/37, fyk 500: 0.0015 bt d.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Min pitch 75 (100 at laps). Max pitch main bars 3h and 400 (concentrated loads 2h and 250); secondary 3.5h and 450 (concentrated 3h and 400).

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: End-supported flights per MST1: U-bars at both landings = 50% area of main bottom steel; A = greatest(0.1 x design span, tension anchorage length, 500); distribution as MS1; construction joint at landing; bars similar to main bottom steel at landing; tension lap/anchorage.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Alternative: landings support flight in a simple concrete recess (20 deep formed recess) - avoids starter congestion; landing starters confined to shaded area; recess continued up flight where in-situ edge wall exists to avoid cracking.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Cantilever flights per MST2: design reinforcement + nominal H8 U-bar; linking H8@300 unless specified; distribution H10@300; bends adjusted on site; main cantilever bars must be mild steel if rebent (see MW3); corner bar detailed with wall; tension anchorage into wall.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Bottom connection: starter bars from prepared surface (when position/height closely controlled) or pocket in ground floor/foundation big enough for cage.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)

rules.rule: Handrail pockets: bars pass around pockets and anchor into main body; inserts need bars passing round or anchorage ties.

source.document: IStructE/Concrete Society - Standard Method of Detailing Structural Concrete, Chapter 6 (pp.97-128)
